Once upon a time:
, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, a boy named Tom lived with his mom and dad. They were very happy.
One day, Tom felt sad. His dad asked, "Why are you sad, Tom?" Tom said, "I lost my toy car. Can you help me find it?" Dad said, "Yes, let's look for your toy car."
They looked all around the house. They looked under the bed, behind the door, and in the toy box. Finally, they found the toy car in the garden. Tom was so happy!
Tom sat down on the grass and felt so comfortable. He said, "Thank you, mom and dad. I feel better now." They all smiled and hugged. Tom felt happy again.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her soft toy cat. She would squeeze it tight and make it wiggle with her hands. She would take her toy cat everywhere she went.
One day, Lucy saw a big tree with a lot of pretty flowers. She thought it would be fun to make the cat climb the tree. Lucy put her toy cat down and started to climb. She tried to hold the toy cat in her hand, but she slipped and fell down. Lucy felt sad and started to cry.
The cat named Lucy saw Lucy cry and wanted to help her. So, Lucy picked up Lucy in her arms and climbed down the tree. She was so happy to have Lucy back. Lucy learned that even when she made a mistake, she could still be brave and help her friend. The moral of the story is to always try your best and be brave when trying something new.
